info.title: Yaya Agent Runtime Events
info.description: Authoritative event contract for command execution, skill lifecycle, sandbox, world, learner projection and Feishu delivery. Producers must persist state, event and outbox atomically. Consumers must deduplicate by event_id and checkpoint sequence per stream_id.

runtimeWss.description: TLS-only WebSocket endpoint advertised by bootstrap.world.stream_url. The host is an environment placeholder; deployed bootstrap responses are authoritative.

runtimeEvents.description: Internal integration-bus stream. This is not the client WebSocket endpoint. sequence is monotonically increasing and gap-free within stream_id.

stream_id.description: Aggregate stream identifier copied from the event envelope.

worldRealtime.description: Bidirectional client WebSocket. A client MUST send exactly one SubscribeFrame or ResumeFrame before any AckFrame. WorldEvent payloads use the exact HTTP backfill item schema.

x-delivery-semantics.checkpoint: AckFrame.sequence is the highest contiguous sequence durably applied for AckFrame.stream_id; the matching event_id prevents acknowledging a different event at that sequence.
x-delivery-semantics.deduplication: Deduplicate by event_id. Repeated stream_id + sequence MUST contain the same event_id and byte-equivalent event; any mismatch is INVARIANT_VIOLATION.
x-delivery-semantics.gap_recovery: On a sequence gap, pause live application and GET bootstrap.world.events_url with after_sequence equal to the last durable checkpoint. Apply only a gap-free page. If backfill returns EVENT_SEQUENCE_GAP or cannot bridge the gap, GET bootstrap.world.snapshot_url, atomically replace local state, set the checkpoint to snapshot.last_event_sequence, then send ResumeFrame.
x-delivery-semantics.reconnect: Send ResumeFrame.after_sequence equal to the last durable checkpoint. The server replays from after_sequence + 1 and may redeliver already observed but unacknowledged events.
x-delivery-semantics.ordering: Never apply sequence N+1 before N for the same stream_id. Events from different stream_id values have no relative ordering.

publishRuntimeEvent.summary: Publish an event after the domain transaction commits.

consumeRuntimeEvent.summary: Consume idempotently and checkpoint only after the projection commits.

receiveRealtimeControl.summary: Receive subscribe, resume, acknowledgement and heartbeat acknowledgement frames from an authenticated client.

sendRealtimeFrame.summary: Send replay/live events, subscription receipts, heartbeats and explicit errors to the client.

bearerAuth.description: Production profile: a tenant-scoped JWT Bearer credential shared with the Game HTTP API. The local Mock token <tenant_id>:<actor_id> is test-only and MUST NOT be treated as a production token format. Authentication failure closes with 4401; authorization failure closes with 4403.

RealtimeWorldEvent.description: Exactly the same event item schema returned by GET bootstrap.world.events_url. This reference is intentionally direct so HTTP backfill and WSS live delivery cannot evolve independently.

x-invariants: sequence is the highest contiguous sequence durably applied for stream_id
event_id identifies the event at sequence; acknowledgements never skip a gap
the first replayed event sequence, when present, equals accepted_after_sequence + 1
to_status is a legal successor of from_status according to the CommandStatus graph
items are strictly sorted by evidence_id
score_delta and confidence have at most six decimal places
inference_sha256 equals YAYA_LEARNER_INFERENCE_HASH_V1 over this payload
